question: Calculate the total number of wickets taken by each bowler (excluding run-outs and other dismissals not attributed to the bowler), their economy rate (total runs conceded divided by total overs bowled, considering only runs scored off the bat and ignoring any extra runs like wides and no-balls), their strike rate (average number of balls bowled per wicket taken), and their best bowling performance in a single match (the match with the most wickets taken by the bowler, formatted as "wickets-runs" where runs are the runs conceded excluding extras).
sql:
SELECT bb.bowler, COUNT(*) as total_balls,
       SUM(CASE WHEN er.extra_type IS NULL OR er.extra_type NOT IN ('wides', 'noballs') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as legal_balls
FROM ball_by_ball bb
LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON bb.match_id = er.match_id 
  AND bb.over_id = er.over_id 
  AND bb.ball_id = er.ball_id 
  AND bb.innings_no = er.innings_no
GROUP BY bb.bowler
HAVING legal_balls = 0

- Batting average is a measure of a batsman's performance, calculated by dividing the total number of runs scored by the number of times they have been dismissed. A higher batting average indicates a more consistent and successful batsman.

function.name: run_sql_query
function.arguments:
{"sql": "-- Per bowler: total wickets, total runs off bat, total legal balls
WITH bowler_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wt.kind_out NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt') 
               THEN wt.match_id || '-' || wt.over_id || '-' || wt.ball_id END) as total_wickets,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs_off_bat,
        SUM(CASE WHEN er.extra_type NOT IN ('wides', 'noballs') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as legal_balls
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
      AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
      AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
      AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON bb.match_id = er.match_id 
      AND bb.over_id = er.over_id 
      AND bb.ball_id = er.ball_id 
      AND bb.innings_no = er.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN wicket_taken wt ON bb.match_id = wt.match_id 
      AND bb.over_id = wt.over_id 
      AND bb.ball_id = wt.ball_id 
      AND bb.innings_no = wt.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
)
SELECT bowler, total_wickets, total_runs_off_bat, legal_balls,
       ROUND(1.0 * total_runs_off_bat / legal_balls * 6, 2) as economy_rate,
